title: Online Generalized-Mean Welfare Maximization: Achieving Near-Optimal Regret from Samples
abstract: arXiv:2602.10469v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study online fair allocation of $T$ sequentially arriving items among $n$ agents with heterogeneous preferences, with the objective of maximizing generalized-mean welfare, defined as the $p$-mean of agents' time-averaged utilities, with $p\in (-\infty, 1)$. We first consider the i.i.d. arrival model and show that the pure greedy algorithm -- which myopically chooses the welfare-maximizing integral allocation -- achieves $\widetilde{O}(1/T)$ average regret. Importantly, in contrast to prior work, our algorithm does not require distributional knowledge and achieves the optimal regret rate using only the online samples.   We then go beyond i.i.d. arrivals and investigate a nonstationary model with time-varying independent distributions. In the absence of additional data about the distributions, it is known that every online algorithm must suffer $\Omega(1)$ average regret. We show that only a single historical sample from each

translated_title: 在线广义平均福利最大化：从样本中实现近最优遗憾
translated_abstract: 我们研究在 n 个具有异质偏好的智能体之间，对顺序到达的 T 个物品进行在线公平分配的问题，目标是最小化广义平均福利，即各智能体时间平均效用的 p-平均（p-mean），其中 p ∈ (-∞, 1)。我们首先考虑独立同分布（i.i.d.）到达模型，并证明纯贪心算法——即每一步短视地选择福利最大化的整数分配——能够实现 Õ(1/T) 的平均遗憾。重要的是，与以往工作不同，我们的算法不需要任何分布知识，仅利用在线样本即可达到最优遗憾率。随后，我们超越 i.i.d. 到达模型，研究了具有时变独立分布的非平稳模型。在缺乏关于分布的额外数据的情况下，已知任何在线算法都必须承受 Ω(1) 的平均遗憾。我们证明，仅需每个（智能体/分布）单个历史样本……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文证明在广义平均福利最大化的在线公平分配问题中，纯贪心算法无需分布知识、仅凭在线样本即可在独立同分布模型下达到最优的 Õ(1/T) 平均遗憾，并在非平稳时变分布模型下仅靠每个智能体的单个历史样本即可突破 Ω(1) 的遗憾下界。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that for online fair allocation with generalized-mean welfare objectives, a pure greedy algorithm achieves the optimal Õ(1/T) average regret in the i.i.d. model using only online samples without distributional knowledge, and that in nonstationary settings a single historical sample per agent suffices to overcome the Ω(1) regret barrier.
